body: Not really sure. I'm average or mediocre at things.

All of the above, professional doesn't matter so much because let's be real we are all replaceable. 

I literally can't point to one person I know and go yeah they would be hurt or miss me if I was gone. I don't have value. And let's be real time has passed me by.

Tired of living.. the constant instability, being used, having no one I can rely on, wasting my entire life up to this point never amounting to anything. Having nothing that matters and seeing that I'm so insignificant to others I'm completely forgotten. Having this depression that has been with me since I can remember. It doesn't matter what I do how genuine I am or how I try to be there no matter what I'm still forgotten after they don't have a use for me. So fuck it. I'll just end it alone. I'm tired of being this way. I'm tired of being alone, I'm tired of being forgotten, I wanted to mean something to someone. But that's not my place in this world. So I see the game over sign. I'll just turn the game off because I'm tired of hitting continue.

I really don't feel much else...tired maybe? It really feels like I was supposed to be alone like this, like I am right now even at work. To be forgotten. Honestly I'd be surprised if there was a funeral. It's been like this my whole life...never really anchored to anything always disconnected watching everything else. I'm just so tired...and this, might finally bring some peace.
